crm_notes: AE notes: Good fit — product team wants predictable costs, clear upgrade path from Hosted -> Dedicated.
PM quote: 'We need a plan that lets us scale quickly in Q3 without surprising bills.'
SE notes: POC showed consistent latencies; need to validate KV cache reuse across sessions for chat context costs.
Pricing notes: Redwood proposal A = 12mo commit, $18k/mo committed, burst up to 3x for 72h windows, overage $0.0009/token; Proposal B = 6mo trial at $10k/mo with higher overage $0.0015/token.
Customer counter: prefers 9mo minimum, wants ramp schedule with credits first 3 months (50% usage credit month1, 25% month2), and hard overage cap at 15% of committed spend per month.
Finance ask: monthly invoicing, ability to convert to quarterly prepay at discounted rate; need clear cost model per 1k tokens for budgeting.
Security: require SSO/SAML, AWS KMS integration, audit logs retained 12 months, EU data residency for EU customers.
Tech concern: wants H100-backed Dedicated nodes for latency-sensitive paths; open to mixed pool (A100 for embeddings) — ask about model pinning and routing rules.
Legal: early termination clause negotiation; customer requests pro-rated refunds for unused committed credits if downgrade after 6 months.
pricing_discussion_detail: Committed tiers discussed: 1) 18k/mo (baseline) -> baseline throughput ~200k tokens/day; 2) 30k/mo (higher reserve) -> baseline ~420k tokens/day.

Burst behavior: Redwood proposed automatic burst up to 3x capacity for up to 72 consecutive hours, subject to network availability; customer requests burst pooling across teams and predictable burst charges.
Overage model: per-token overage vs percentage of committed spend. Customer pushing for blended overage cap and a flat unit overage price for forecasting.
Ramp schedule: Customer wants 3-month ramp: month1 commit pricing credited 50%, month2 credited 25%, month3 full. Redwood prefers amortizing credits across first 6 months.
poC_results: Latency: p50 60ms, p95 120ms under 80% load (512-token prompts).
Accuracy/quality: baseline model (open-llama variant) meets pass rate for intent classification at 92% on internal evaluation set.
Token usage profile: average 380 tokens per chat turn (including context + assistant), embeddings used for doc search ~0.3 million vectors/day in trial.
Cost sims: at projected Q3 traffic, Hosted API run-rate ~monthy $35k without reserved capacity; Dedicated commit reduces unit cost by estimated 30-45% depending on quantization and batching.
legal_and_contract_items: SOW: include explicit SLA 99.95% availability for Dedicated; credits formula agreed in principle pending legal language.
Termination: customer wants 60-day out after month6; Redwood standard is 90-day with early termination fee.
